run_create_uma_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI to create UMA fine-tuning dataset YAML configs from ASE atoms directories
create_yaml_finetune_configs: create YAML config files for UMA model fine-tuning with train and validation dataset paths
launch_processing_ase_atoms: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms object directories into fine-tuning dataset format
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
review_create_yaml_function: review the create_yaml function that populates UMA fine-tune template YAMLs with dataset paths and model config
